answer: Divergent-Execution Rafts: split the agent graph into shards; only identities that produce divergent state transitions across shards (verified by replaying on a wharf of cheap verifiers) earn write access. Clones replay identically, so they collapse to one shard slot. Cost to attacker: maintaining N distinct execution traces across a glacier of historical checkpoints, each divergence logged as a marble in the shard's state merkle—divergent traces require real, non-shared compute and storage, scaling linearly per sybil.
